title: notification.requested (v1)
description: Published by core-service (outbox -> Kafka topic connectone.events.v1, key = customerId, header event-type = notification.requested, header correlation-id). Consumed by notification-service. Delivery is AT-LEAST-ONCE: consumers must be idempotent on (customerId, idempotencyKey). Compatible changes: ADD optional fields. Breaking changes need a new event type or topic version.

eventId.description: UUID of this event instance (differs between publications of the same business event)

customerId.description: core-service customer_profile.id (a reference, not a foreign key)

userId.description: core-service app_user.id; used by the consumer to authorise 'my notifications'

idempotencyKey.description: Stable business key, e.g. payment-52933-SUCCEEDED. Duplicate => ignored.
